catboost: Run on the shared one-hot features (not CatBoost's native categorical handling) for a like-for-like comparison.
ebm: Explainable Boosting Machine: additive + a few pairwise terms, intrinsically interpretable.
huber: Outlier-robust linear fit - relevant for mis-priced listings.
knn: Distance-based; sensitive to feature scaling and one-hot dimensionality.
lasso: L1: sparse coefficients, doubles as embedded feature selection.
linear: OLS on log price. Interpretable; unstable when many one-hot columns are collinear.
mean_baseline: Predicts the arithmetic mean training price. The floor every model must beat.
median_baseline: Predicts the median training price (robust to the expensive tail). Also the MASE reference.
mlp: Included for completeness. With <1k tabular rows a neural net is not expected to win; if it does not, that is the (documented) result.
